A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PaperBanana and contain 49 readable pages, including corresponding equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-H. Full text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, agent ablations, statistical-plot experiments and human evaluations in Section 5, Tables 1-2 and Figures 4-5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark, ablation, statistical-plot and human-evaluation results, including the supporting appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix G retain the same five-agent workflow, reference retrieval, style guidance, three refinement rounds and code-based extension for statistical plots.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same NeurIPS 2025 methodology diagrams and ChartMimic-derived statistical plots. Human-diagram enhancement and coding-versus-image-generation scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparators remain unchanged, including vanilla and few-shot Nano-Banana-Pro, GPT-Image-1.5, Paper2Any and vanilla Gemini-3-Pro in their respective experiments. AutoFigure-Edit is newly cited but is not evaluated.

E3.justification: Both retain the 292/292 diagram and 240/240 plot test/reference partitions, the same judge models, 50-case human-evaluation samples, hierarchical scoring rules and generation settings.

E4.justification: Table 2's agent ablations, Section 6's enhancement and visualization comparisons, and Appendix A's case studies and failure analyses are unchanged. Figure 6 receives attribution without changing the example.

E5.justification: Kendall's tau agreement analyses and human-judge aggregation remain identical. Seed, repeated-run, confidence-interval and significance-test reporting does not change.

E6.justification: All experimental values and findings are retained. For example, Table 1 still reports overall scores of 60.2 for PaperBanana with Nano-Banana-Pro and 43.2 for vanilla Nano-Banana-Pro. Ablation results, plotted comparisons and appendix examples are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The task formalization and agent equations (1)-(7) are unchanged. Neither version adds or removes theoretical assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about automated illustration, PaperBananaBench, baseline superiority and extension to statistical plots.

C2.justification: Interpretations, failure explanations and limitations remain substantively unchanged. Section 9 adds AutoFigure-Edit as another cited example of the existing OCR/SAM3 reconstruction approach, without changing the proposed solution or raster-editability limitation.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, data-curation instructions, reproduction descriptions, style guidelines and prompts remain unchanged, including Appendices C-H. Project access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds AutoFigure-Edit (Lin et al., 2026) to Sections 7.1 and 9, and Kim et al. (2025) as Figure 6's source. AutoFigure's publication update and AutomatiKZ's revised author entry refer to works already cited in v1.

P1.justification: Limited edits update citation wording, bibliographic author/publication details, the Figure 6 attribution and date/version text. Section organization and nearly all prose remain unchanged; all appendix text is identical.

P2.justification: Figure 6's discussion gains a source-attribution footnote, its caption punctuation changes slightly, and nearby prose and references reflow. Figure artwork, plot displays and table structures remain unchanged; all appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 supplies the previously missing Figure 6 source credit, acknowledges AutoFigure-Edit and updates incomplete bibliographic entries. These changes modestly improve attribution and research context, while the methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility material and limitations remain unchanged.
